parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: ModuleCode
parameters.description:
The code of the feature. Valid values:

*   **vulFix**: vulnerability fixing.
*   **cloudSiem**: threat analysis and response.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas add-sas-module-trial --module-code vulFix --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas AddSasModuleTrial --region cn-hangzhou --ModuleCode vulFix --Lang zh
